gameStory.articleHeadline: AJ Barner has a TD catch and runs for a score in Seahawks' 17-3 win over Cardinals
gameStory.articleDescription: — AJ Barner's breakout came just when the Seahawks needed it.
gameStory.articleStory: SEATTLE -- — AJ Barner's breakout came just when the Seahawks needed it. Barner caught a touchdown pass and ran for a score, and Seattle beat the Arizona Cardinals 17-3 on Sunday without starting quarterback Sam Darnold. Backup Drew Lock completed 19 of 28 passes for 175 yards and a touchdown for the Seahawks (5-4), who rebounded from a 34-17 loss at home on Monday night to Chicago. Barner's two touchdowns were the tight end's first this season. “We understand what kind of player he is. So we can kind of feel the frustration with him of like what he expects from himself,” Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said. “But just no flinch, just keep attacking it, you know. And he’s a leader on our offense, and he provides so much great energy.” Jaxon Smith-Njigba caught seven passes for 51 yards in just his second game this season with fewer than 100 yards. He now has 1.036 yards on the season, becoming the third player in franchise history — along with Hall of Famer Steve Largent and Tyler Lockett — with three consecutive 1,000-yard receiving seasons. Smith-Njigba is the first NFL receiver to reach 1,000 yards this year. Gardner Minshew, known to fans in the Pacific Northwest because of his stellar 2018 season at Washington State, took over as the Cardinals' starting quarterback this week after leading Arizona to a come-from-behind overtime victory over Dallas. whatToWatch.text: Darnold and Cross headline five Seahawks ruled out, so Seattle is laying 8.5 at home with holes in two of the most important spots on the field — whoever's under center gets protection questions answered in a hurry.

The defense has been the identity all year: 19.9 points allowed per game through eight games, against a Cardinals unit coughing up 29.8. If Seattle controls the line, this one can get away from Arizona early.

A 39.5 total says Vegas expects a grinder, and both teams average 2.25 sacks a game — with Arizona missing Isaiah Adams and Jon Gaines II up front, every third down is a chance for Seattle to snap the one-game skid at home.

recap.text: AJ Barner did it all Sunday, bulldozing in from a yard out and later hauling in a 7-yard strike from Drew Lock as Seattle smothered Arizona 17-3. Filling in for the injured Sam Darnold, Lock was steady rather than spectacular — 19 of 28 for 175 yards and the score — and that was plenty against a Cardinals offense that managed just a Chad Ryland field goal in the opening quarter. Jaxon Smith-Njigba's seven grabs for 51 yards pushed him past 1,000 yards on the season, and Jason Myers tacked on a 45-yarder in the third to put the game out of reach. Neither side turned the ball over, but only one of them found the end zone — and the 5-4 Seahawks washed out Monday night's loss to Chicago in the process.

newsBlurb.text: Drew Lock steps back under center at Lumen Field with Sam Darnold sidelined by a quad injury — the second time this season Seattle faces Arizona without its starting quarterback, after Darnold's glute kept him out of the Week 2 rematch in the desert. Mike Macdonald's banged-up QB room got reinforcements this week in former UFL MVP Adrian Martinez, signed off the 49ers' roster before Wednesday's practice. The Seahawks will break out the college navy jersey-and-pants combination for the occasion.
